tabs.html:
VSOL V1600D4-DP/BT 4-Port EPON OLT – High-Performance Optical Line Terminal

The V1600D4-DP/BT is a compact, high-performance 4-port EPON OLT designed for fiber-optic networks, FTTH (Fiber-to-the-Home), and enterprise applications. This 1U rack-mountable OLT offers exceptional scalability, high-speed data transmission, and dual power module support, making it an ideal solution for ISPs, telecom operators, and large-scale fiber deployments.

Key Features & Benefits

  • 4 EPON Ports – Supports up to 256 ONU connections with a 1:64 splitting ratio per port.
  • High-Speed Uplinks – 4 x GE RJ45 ports + 4 x 10GE SFP+ ports for seamless data transmission.
  • Dual Power Modules (AC/DC) – Ensures maximum reliability and uninterrupted operation.
  • 1U Rack-Mountable Design – Space-efficient, easy to install in data centers and network cabinets.
  • Energy Efficient & Low Power Consumption – Optimized for high performance with minimal energy usage.

Technical Specifications

  • Model: V1600D4-DP/BT
  • PON Ports: 4 x EPON (SFP slots, PX20++/PX20+++ compatible)
  • Uplink Ports: 4 x 1GE RJ45 + 4 x 10GE SFP+
  • Splitting Ratio: 1:64 per PON port
  • Backplane Bandwidth: 128 Gbps
  • Port Forwarding Rate: 71.424 Mpps
  • Power Supply: Dual AC/DC options (100–240V AC, -36V to -75V DC)
  • Power Consumption: 30W (Energy Efficient)
  • Operating Temperature: -20°C to +60°C
  • Storage Temperature: -40°C to +70°C
  • Humidity: 5%–95% (non-condensing)
  • Chassis: 1U 19-inch rack-mountable design

Ideal Applications

  • FTTH / FTTP / FTTB Deployments – Provides fast, stable fiber connections for residential and commercial users.
  • Enterprise & Campus Networks – Ensures high-bandwidth, low-latency connectivity for businesses.
  • Smart Cities & IoT Applications – Supports IoT, automation, and real-time monitoring solutions.
  • ISPs & Telecom Providers – Cost-effective, scalable EPON technology for broadband services.

Why Choose the V1600D4-DP/BT EPON OLT?

  • Reliable & Scalable – Handles up to 256 ONUs with high-speed uplinks.
  • Future-Proof Networking – Advanced PON technology for long-term fiber expansion.
  • Dual Power Module Support – Redundant AC/DC power for maximum uptime.
  • Compact & Energy-Efficient – 1U rack-mountable with low power consumption.
